message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "verify_laterality_before_mass_interpretation", "description": "When interpreting chest imaging for masses or mediastinal shifts, systematically verify anatomical laterality markers before concluding on side-specific findings.", "applicable_conditions": "Any task involving the interpretation of chest X-rays or CT scans where spatial orientation, mass location, or mediastinal displacement is relevant.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": [], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the task requires identifying the side of a mass, effusion, or mediastinal shift: (1) First, locate and confirm laterality markers such as the gastric bubble (typically left), liver shadow (typically right), heart apex (typically left), and aortic knob; (2) Explicitly state the confirmed orientation (e.g., 'Image is standard PA view with left-sided gastric bubble'); (3) Only then describe the location of the pathology relative to these verified landmarks. Do not assume standard orientation without visual confirmation."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
